tasks.title: Video dashboard: file-drop card creation
tasks.notes: Add a drop zone to the dashboard so dragging/uploading a small metadata file creates a new source_ready card. File format: YAML frontmatter only (title, notebook, focusPrompt). Architectural note: user-created cards can't go in DEFAULT_VIDEOS (hardcoded), so they need a new localStorage key (e.g. video-dashboard-user-cards). Two sources of cards at render time: DEFAULT_VIDEOS + localStorage user cards.

tasks.title: Video dashboard: card editing
tasks.notes: Allow inline editing of card fields (title, notebook, notes, artifactId, skipYt, focusPrompt, nlmTitle). nlmTitle is the cryptic name NLM assigns to a generated video â€” added by editing the card after NLM creates the video, since NLM doesn't allow renaming. This field is the mapping between the card's display title and what to look for in NLM. Trigger: right-click â†’ Edit, or double-click title. For DEFAULT_VIDEOS cards, edits persist as localStorage overrides (similar to status overrides). For user-created cards, edits update the user-cards store directly. Design the override merge strategy before building.
